# ZetsApp

> ZetsApp builds and sells custom software, AI solutions, and ready-to-use SaaS products for startups and enterprises. We also publish in-depth engineering guides and host a directory of business software with pricing, features, and reviews.

ZetsApp helps businesses **build**, **buy**, and **compare** software:
- Custom software development (web & mobile apps)
- AI & machine learning services (LLM apps, AI agents, RAG pipelines)
- AI automation for business workflows and processes
- SaaS products ready to adopt today
- A searchable directory of business software (CRM, HR, security, AI, collaboration, and more)

## About
- [About ZetsApp](https://www.zetsapp.com/about): Who we are, how we ship, and where we work — company positioning, engineering process, and compliance posture (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2).

## Featured ZetsApp software (AI & operations, set up for your business)
- [ZetDesk AI Receptionist](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/ai-receptionist): 24/7 AI phone receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, qualifies leads and sends call summaries.
- [ZetAnswer AI Call Assistant](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/ai-call-answering-assistant): answers your mobile when you are busy, driving or on-site; missed-call text-back for contractors and solo owners.
- [ZetMaint CMMS](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/cmms-software): work orders, preventive maintenance scheduling (calendar + run-hours), assets, spare parts, offline technician app.
- [FieldOps Pro — Field Service Management](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/fieldops-pro): technician scheduling, AI dispatch, quotes, invoices and on-site payments.
- [ZetBook AI Appointment Booking](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/ai-appointment-booking): bookings by phone, website chat and WhatsApp with reminders and waitlists.
- [ZetChat WhatsApp AI Chatbot](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/whatsapp-ai-chatbot): official WhatsApp Business API chatbot for sales, support and bookings.
- [ChatPilot — AI Chatbot for Websites](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/chatpilot): chatbot trained on your own content with cited answers and lead capture.
- [ZetVoice AI Voice Agent](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/zetvoice-ai): outbound/inbound AI calls for speed-to-lead, qualification, reminders and support.
- [ZetFollow Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/ai-lead-follow-up-automation): instant multi-channel lead response and nurturing.
- [RelateCRM — CRM for Small Business](https://www.zetsapp.com/software/relate-crm): simple pipeline CRM with auto-logged calls, email and WhatsApp.
